contract: Packed1800-byte58x30 diamond; left crops30 pixels, right retains28. Clip3 selects lower half at row0;4 upper half.

2..6 footprints retain diagonal order and original origin per tile, with actual C/native clippers and raster children. C clip dimensions carry the native signedWORD domain.
possible_original_bugs: Left edge repeats a DWORD on row15 and an earlier high EAX WORD on row25. Both visible quirks preserved in masked/unmasked paths.
ghidra: Six void/two-argument raster and five int/no-argument composer prototypes applied; all13 owners/comments recorded. Native signatures do not acquire C context parameters.
